lesson: Static OV weight directions were useful when they matched causal tests: L9 H4 preserved AND/NOT and true/false contrast (.01677) and its ablation dropped boolean_logic by .383 vs .040 on control, so it is a real relay.

High activation enrichment alone was not enough: several MLP candidates looked strong by scan but failed screens, e.g. L36 u7470 month_offset dropped -0.043, L36 u9299 tense only .023, L28 u13209+6105 fraction .005, and L36 u12854+2819 letter_case .005.

Some apparent composite circuits were non-causal or redundant: L9 H4+H5 ablation gave boolean_logic .380, but H5 alone actually improved boolean by .062, so decomposing a pair can reveal one head is the true driver.

Cross-skill bleed was common, so use selectivity checks: the passed Boolean head also moved product_sign by .077, while the rejected month/tense/fraction/letter_case MLP screens had weak target effects and often failed held-out checks.

Calendar and grammatical weights should be treated as hypotheses, not discoveries: month-offset and tense heads had plausible OV mappings, but their causal drops stayed tiny or negative (e.g. month_offset -0.132 for L9 H34+35, yet single MLP candidates were only .023 or failed), so weight evidence needs ablation confirmation.
